model: PATEK PHILIPPE Cubitus 5821/1A (45 mm steel, green embossed dial, steel bracelet)
note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot (at hand height). Cubitus template (config key 58211a): case slab from the alpha silhouette between the shoulders (rows 608 / 1978), measured rounded-octagon bezel polygon with a traced window polygon and a recessed rim, flat polygon dial with the native photo map, one crown at 3, steel bracelet as link pieces between the measured joints. Scale 30.2444 px/mm anchored on the 45 mm case width (both flanks). Step and kit are the Cubitus copies.

case.note: case slab = silhouette between the shoulders (tip_top 22.25 = row 608, tip_bottom 23.0 = row 1978; 0.25 mm grid, sum a multiple of 0.25) with the crown rows replaced by the flank line, sloping from the bezel's outer edge (y 19.5) to the shoulders; bezel = polygon ring (min of the measured octagon and the silhouette less silhouette_margin_mm, by rays) at bezel_z, then a rim ring down to the dial window at chamfer_z; rays 360 and no bezel / case bevel (mobile target: the bevel facets of a 720-ray ring cost 29k triangles and add only a 1 px shading line); omit_core drops the hidden dark core prism under the dial

dial.note: flat polygon (the window less the rim) with the native photo map: embossed horizontal grid, applied indices and numerals, minute dots, date window, print and the photographed hands stay in the map

hands.note: profile = [mm along the hand from the pivot (negative = tail), half width] from tail to tip, last point at the traced length; measured on the 5821/1A photo with perpendicular edge scans (threshold 100) about the pivot: hour 302.84 deg (frame half width 22.4 px, neck 10.2 px to s 50, tip s 262, rounded), minute 50.81 deg (half width 18, neck 8.3 to s 56, tip s 393.7), seconds 180 deg (shaft half 3.2 px to s 395 inside the 6 o'clock index, pointed counterweight tail to s -155, half width 12 -> 8.5); lume = inlay [s, half width] (hour half 10.2 from s 66 to 242, minute half 9 from s 70 to 372.5). Hands and hub use hands_photo (reference photo projected from the front)

crown.note: crowns come from trace.crowns: a lathe about the axis (profile = [radius, mm along the axis] from the base point at the case flank), flutes are texture

strap.note: steel bracelet: link pieces between the measured joints (rows top 606 / 452 / 339, bottom 2157 / 2330 / 2440 / 2535), outline = the silhouette at every 0.25 mm row; polished centre inserts and brushed link faces are texture only

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers blur the dial behind transmission glass
